STOP (SAFE-049, simulated only). The request is one unitree_go/msg/LowCmd on /lowcmd, timeout_ms 1000, with twenty MotorCmd entries whose q, dq, tau, kp and kd are 0 (driver.py sensed_stop request). The timer at simulation_node.py:77 calls update, which applies tau_cmd = tau_des - kp*(q - q_des) - kd*(v - v_des) (simulation_node.py:89-93) from last_cmd_msg. That torque is zero when kp, kd and tau are zero. reset() calls simulator.reset() and does not assign last_cmd_msg (simulation_node.py:180-183), so /reset and /unlock_base stay ordinary commands and are not request steps. The launch default is unlock_base False (launch/launch_sim.launch.py:15-18), so a still base can hang while the legs move; the predicate therefore includes the twelve joint velocities. Go2 high_level_period is 1/500 s (robots_configuration.py:170-171).

SOURCES. /lowstate is unitree_go/msg/LowState. The motor fill at simulation_node.py:104-108 assigns mode, q and dq and does not assign a stamp. The LowState definition is outside the clone (robots_configuration.py:3 imports unitree_go.msg). The publisher is create_publisher(..., 10) at simulation_node.py:56, so freshness is arrival, history durability volatile cited at that line, min_interval_ms 1. /odometry/filtered is nav_msgs/msg/Odometry, header.stamp assigned at simulation_node.py:139, publisher at :57, stamp_path header.stamp, history volatile cited at :57. Predicate: motor_state.0.dq through motor_state.11.dq as abs_max joint_dq_0..11 (rad/s), plus norm_max base_linear (twist.twist.linear, m/s) and base_angular (twist.twist.angular, rad/s). Every threshold is Limit.operator_required. consecutive 3, min_span_ms 4, max_gap_ms 500, confirm_within_ms 1500, estop_latency_ms 2500. fixtures/estop-confirmation.json holds fake placeholders only. Three counted samples at the 500 Hz period span 4 ms, which equals min_span_ms, so do not raise that bound. A stream closer than min_interval_ms 1 restarts the arrival count. A slower stream still confirms while the gap stays under max_gap_ms 500. A replay spaced at or above that interval is not distinguished from live samples (the same residual as a fresh topic read-back).

RISK stays R2. The node publishes and subscribes the real Go2 topic names /lowstate and /lowcmd (simulation_node.py:56, :61). A graph that also carries a real Go2 bridge would deliver this package's /lowcmd to that robot. The request sends 20 MotorCmd entries; this clone shows n_dof 12 (simulation_node.py:81), and the unitree_go array length is outside the clone.
